description: ERC-20 token balance of any address on 7 EVM chains, returned raw and decimal-formatted with the token symbol, so agents never mis-scale USDC (6) vs 18-decimal tokens. You only pay for successful reads: invalid input, not-found and upstream errors cancel settlement. ($0.002 USDC on Base)

chain.description: base (default), ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc or avalanche. Chain IDs also accepted.
